# R04 host skill contract cases

[中文](README_cn.md) · [EOS owner contract](../../../docs/eos/interfaces/skills/native/host-abi.md) · [Rust design](../../../docs/eos/design/runtime/skills/host-rust.md) · [First use](../../../docs/eos/develop/host-skills.md)

`selection.json` is a shape example for the IsOS-owned `isos/skill-selection.json`; the digest strings and private paths are placeholders, not verified package evidence. `cases.json` freezes the R04 implementation and boundary replay plan. Test code must construct real P01 receipts and actual library hashes at runtime, then mutate each named boundary. A static case list does not prove implementation. `python3 check_cases.py` checks IDs, required boundaries, negative classes and JSON shape. R04-21 inspects the guest-visible environment and descriptors to prove that private re-exec forwards no IsOS grant, secret or device handle.

The end-to-end replay must pair the selected IsOS builder with the actual default Rust `aether-runtime`, not the opt-in C++ worker. Use a minimal ABI v2 fixture library with an atomically counted `execute` handler, one declared primitive and a fake Dispatcher adapter. Verify that data-invalid cases create no worker; descriptor-invalid cases may run constructor/query inside the confined worker but leave the handler count at zero; undeclared primitive sends no Dispatcher command. Capture process PIDs and reap results, plus one shared `run_id` and `execution_id`. Preserve complete commands and outputs in `logs/test/<run-id>/` before marking R04 complete.

The process fixture in `crates/aether-runtime/tests/host_skill_catalog.rs` compiles selected old-prefix C guests for success, denied primitive and blocked non-reentrant runs. It checks a real managed `base.velocity` journal entry and `primitive.ack`, the invocation denial latch and queued cancellation. The private Dispatcher release-race tests live in `crates/aether-dispatcher/tests/gateway_stop.rs`. The merged EOS/IsOS checked-retirement replay is recorded in the [first-use guide](../../../docs/eos/develop/host-skills.md#exact-merged-tip-r04-checked-retirement-qualification-2026-11-02).

`preflight_cases.json` freezes eight cross-owner candidate checks: structured response, bad ABI or missing readiness binding preserving the old serving run, revision/generation binding, inert process boundary, near-boundary timeout and checked candidate-grant cleanup, malformed output, launch-time TOCTOU recheck and automatic child restart. `check_cases.py` validates IDs, fields, boundaries and IsOS diagnostic codes. The exact merged-tip live replay covers confirmed and unknown old Stop, retry fences, retained events and a saved-graph launch recheck; the full live 90-second timeout and post-probe executable/library mutation are not shown by that replay. Focused tests and earlier controlled mutation runs provide separate evidence. R06 actuator stop/simulator reap has its own qualification gate.
